newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office Products says Q4 on track.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office Products says Q4 on track.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said on Thursday its fourth quarter sales performance, unit comparisons and operating margins continued to track analysts' consensus estimates for the fourth quarter.

"We are concerned that U.S. Office Products' share price may have declined in the marketplace due to recently announced earnings per share shortfalls by industry competitors," Chairman Jonathan Ledecky said.
Ledecky said the reasons behind competitors' shortfalls, including paper price fluctuations and declining operating margins, were not relevant to its operating performance.
The First Call consensus earnings estimate was $0.30 per share versus $0.19 per share earned in last year's fourth quarter.
"We would also like to point out that USOP enjoys one of the strongest balance sheets and operating cash flows in the office products industry today," Ledecky said.
The company had significant financial resources and commitments from leading financial institutions with which to enhance shareholder value, it said.
Its acquisition backlog was also robust, U.S. Office Products said.
U.S. Office Products supplies of a range of office products and business services to corporate, commercial, industrial and educational customers.
